The vendor directly providing **Ticket Tailor** at **tickettailor.com** is **Zimma Ltd** (trading as **Ticket Tailor**).

### Supporting Evidence
According to the Ticket Tailor *Terms and Conditions* and *Website Terms of Use* at `tickettailor.com`:
> *"Tickettailor.com and buytickets.at and any of their sub-domains is a site operated by Ticket Tailor, which is the trading name of Zimma Ltd ('we', 'our', 'us'). We are registered in England and Wales under company number 07583551..."*
